text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
A whirlwind of diverse emotions clashed in 
this "Takarazuka Kinen."

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Some pursue their own ideal running, some 
stand as a wall in the way, and some 
strive to overcome that very wall.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
And Mejiro Bright, too, stepped onto the 
turf of Hanshin, ready to face the dawning 
of a new era.
